quests.name: A Gaoled Awakening
quests.premise: Break out of a forced-labour dig site and survive the escape.

quests.name: Tale's Beginning

quests.name: In Dragon's Wake
quests.premise: Rest up at Borderwatch Outpost, then head for Melve after news of an attack.

quests.name: Seat of the Sovran
quests.premise: Travel to the capital and prove who you really are.

quests.name: Convergence

quests.name: Lost Rites dungeons
quests.area: Vermund, Battahl and the Unmoored World
quests.premise: Twelve repeatable dungeons added to the original map, each with gear for every vocation.
quests.unlock: Talk to Captain Brant at the Stardrop Inn, Vernworth, at night and ask about the uncovered ruins.
tips: Final chests give Offering Flames, needed for Norgan's Obelisks.
Final Proving Ground opens after you clear two other Unmoored World Lost Rites.
Vermund: Devilkin Hollow, Daemon's Corral, Sunken Spire, Interminable Corridor.
Battahl: Mired Conduit, Embersand Mine, Shrouded Warren, Precipitous Catacombs, Wyrmsblood Arena.
Unmoored World: Molten Gauntlet, Seafloor Sepulcher, Final Proving Ground.

areas.name: Vermund
areas.summary: human kingdom ruled by a line of Sovran who earned the throne by defeating the Dragon; starting kingdom, west/central map.

areas.name: Battahl
areas.summary: kingdom of the Beastren, a different culture and nation, reached by crossing the border; arid south-east.

areas.name: Unmoored World
areas.summary: secret endgame region reached through a choice in Legacy; own NPCs, trials and post-game quests.

areas.name: Norgan
areas.summary: snowy Far North region, separate map, own Portcrystals.

areas.name: Borderwatch Outpost
areas.summary: where you land after escaping the excavation site; has a Riftstone, shops, inn, lounge; first side quests (Provisioner's Plight, Ordeals of a New Recruit). Exit leads to northern Vermund and Mt. Alles base.

areas.name: Melve
areas.summary: small burnt-out town southwest of the Outpost; inn, apothecary, houses, helpers needed; crafting materials on the edges.

areas.name: Vernworth
areas.summary: the capital; Common, Merchant, Noble, Mercantile and Residential districts, Slums, Castle (gaol tower, vault, audience chamber), Gracious Hand, Pawn and Vocation Guilds. Hub for most main quests and ~25 side quests.

areas.name: Harve Village
areas.summary: coastal village south of Trevo Mine, southwest of Vernworth; Northern Harve Ruins nearby hold bandits and a cell with loot.

areas.name: Sacred Arbor
areas.summary: woodland settlement north of Vernworth around the Arborheart tree (Riftstone); woodcutters and craftsmen (Grisha, Glyndwr); Grisha's Armory.

areas.name: Moonglow Garden
areas.summary: Beren's recruit-training area (Claw Them Into Shape).

areas.name: Nameless Village
areas.summary: north of the Eastern Forest; a thief-run village (Srail) with an underground obstacle course and Depths; missable story quest.

areas.name: Checkpoint Rest Town
areas.summary: border settlement between Vermund and Battahl; Celeste's Smithy, Ibrahim's Scrap Store, Myrddin's Home, Pawn/Vocation facilities; many shops.

areas.name: Ancient Battleground
areas.summary: found by following the road out of Checkpoint Rest Town; ruined castle site with a Cyclops chest, locked rooms (Oskar's key quest).

areas.name: Mountain Shrine
areas.summary: cave reachable only after speaking with the Sphinx; riddle site.

areas.name: Moonglint Tower
areas.summary: special location open only during and after the endgame.

areas.name: Bakbattahl
areas.summary: capital of Battahl; Flamebearer Palace, Gaol, Pawn/Vocation guilds, Oxcart Station, Wanderer's Haven, Isaac's Wares, Brokkr's Smithy, Awaran's Arms; ropeway network.

areas.name: Agamen Volcanic Island
areas.summary: volcanic region with Volcanic Island Camp (Armory, Riftstone, Geyser Hamlet hot spring), Drabnir's Grotto; hosts Magick Archer and Warfarer vocation quests.

areas.name: Seafloor Shrine
areas.summary: submerged, opened after Convergence; armories (Vermundian, Battahli, Dwarven, Elven), guild branches.

areas.name: Excavation Site
areas.summary: northern digsite with Overseers' Lodge, Agamen Ruins and apothecary (Zachary).

areas.name: Flamebearer Palace
areas.summary: Beastren seat of power; audience chamber, prayer hall, Empress's chambers.

areas.name: Battahl wilds
areas.summary: Wild areas of Battahl: Wyrmsblood Forest, Indigent Bedlands, Misty Marshes, Malachite Forest, Windworn Gully.

areas.name: Norgandian Settlement
areas.summary: Your base in Norgan. Has a Portcrystal, the relic appraiser and, after Hammer and Tongs, Hal's workshop.

areas.name: Norgan travel
areas.summary: Only Norgan Portcrystals work in Norgan. Fixed ones: Norgandian Settlement, Rivercave Campground (north of the settlement) and Shrine of Wisdom (far north-west). You also get a free portable one after Chilling Tidings that can only be placed in Norgan.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 1: Eyes
tips.body: Hand over the Sealing Phial. It is in the chest above the doorway that opens nearby.
steps: Reward: Wakestone.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 2: Madness
tips.body: Bring the pawn or person you are closest to. Carrying your pawn onto the platform also works.
steps: Reward: Portcrystal.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 3: Wisdom
tips.body: Bring a pawn named SphinxFather, SphinxMother or SphinxParent. Search the rift for one by name.
steps: Reward: 1,200 Rift Crystals.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 4: Conviction
tips.body: Hand over any item at all.
steps: Reward: the submitted item.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 5: Rumination
tips.body: Hand over a Finder's Token. It appears where you picked up your first Seeker's Token.
steps: Reward: Ferrystone.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 6: Reunion
tips.body: Go to the Frontier Shrine in Battahl.
steps: Reward: Gold.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 7: Recollection
tips.body: Bring the right number of statues.
steps: Reward: Unmaking Arrow.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 8: Contest
tips.body: Beat the enemy she sends at you.
steps: Reward: Ring of Ambition.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 9: Futility
tips.body: Bring Maurits to the amphora, or carry the amphora to Maurits.
steps: Reward: Eternal Bond.

tips.name: Sphinx riddle 10: Differentiation
tips.body: Bring a pawn named Vergil or Dante.
steps: Reward: Whimsical Daydream.

tips.name: Sphinx finale
tips.body: After her riddles you can fight the Sphinx. Beating her gives the Key of Sagacity, which opens a big chest holding an Eternal Wakestone. The Unmaking Arrow makes it much easier, but only an Archer or Warfarer can fire it.

tips.name: Where the Sphinx is
tips.body: Her riddles start at the Mountain Shrine in Vermund and continue at the Frontier Shrine in Battahl.

tips.name: Rock lizards near Checkpoint Rest Town
tips.body: A campfire near Checkpoint Rest Town has lots of rock lizards (about 624 XP each). Further along are an armoured Cyclops (about 2,678), two Minotaurs (about 3,296 each) and a hidden Chimera (about 5,047).
steps: Take the west Vernworth oxcart (about 200 gold).
Go down the bridge and follow the stream to a cave.
Keep right, climb out and cross the wooden bridge to the campfire.

tips.name: Go to Bakbattahl early
tips.body: Enemies around Bakbattahl give 200 to 500 XP each, against 100 to 150 near Vernworth. The Guerco Cavern route is easier (one Stone Golem and a Chimera). The northern canyon from Checkpoint is harder.

tips.name: Griffin near Melve
tips.body: Players report the Griffin near the tower by Melve gives about 7,000 XP and respawns. Not yet confirmed by us.

tips.name: Hobgoblins west of Bakbattahl
tips.body: Use the campfire south of Bakbattahl's western road. Hobgoblins give about 295 to 550 XP each.

tips.name: Volcanic Island
tips.body: Strong XP after you unlock Magick Archer or Warfarer there. Martyr's Bolt can drop a Drake in one or two hits, at a cost to your health.

tips.name: Road to Dragonsbreath Tower
tips.body: Knackers (about 417 XP), Redwolves (about 479) and Lost Mercenaries (about 556). Bring a ranged weapon for the Gore Harpies.

tips.name: Drakes and Lost Rites
tips.body: Drakes and the repeatable Lost Rites dungeons (Dark Arisen) give the most XP late in the game.

tips.name: Levelling basics
tips.body: Big groups add up: about ten goblins are worth one Cyclops. Resting at a campfire respawns many enemies. Cook food with a camping kit for stat boosts. Cyclops and Minotaurs come back about every 3 in-game days, Drakes about every 7. Area-damage pawns (Sorcerer, Warrior) clear groups faster. The Ring of Ambition gives a little extra XP. Warfarer splits XP across every vocation you have unlocked. To level one vocation fast, keep only that one unlocked.

tips.name: Base game endings
tips.body: Flee from the Dragon and agree: bad ending. Fight and defeat the Dragon: good ending. True ending: you need the Empowered Godsbane Blade. Talk to the Pathfinder instead of taking the throne, retry the fight, ride the Dragon to its chest and use the blade. This opens the Unmoored World. Not uncovering the truth unlocks New Game Plus.

tips.name: Dark Arisen endings
tips.body: Normal: spare Ser Rovall's remains in The Castle in the Ice, then finish Reunion and beat the Fallen Dragon. Bad: destroy the remains and fight Eir, which ends your game (reload). True: after Reunion, finish Into Rancor and beat Satanachia in Nifhel Depth.

tips.name: Helping Eir in the dragon fight
tips.body: Helping Eir against the Fallen Dragon only changes some later dialogue. Running to Rovall's soul instead saves time.

tips.name: Romance
tips.body: People reported as romance options: Ulrika and Wilhelmina in the base game, and Eir in Dark Arisen (not yet confirmed).

tips.name: Hard Mode
tips.body: Dark Arisen added a free Hard Mode for everyone. Enemies hit harder and take more, and you earn more XP and DCP.

tips.name: Spoils (Norgan relics)
tips.body: Norgan drops unappraised Spoils. Get them appraised at the settlement for random stats. Hal's workshop can make some pieces outright after Hammer and Tongs.

tips.name: Obelisks of Benediction
tips.body: Nine Obelisks in Norgan teach new weapon skills (none for Warfarer). To use one fully, bring an Offering Flame from the last chest of a Lost Rites dungeon.
steps: Mage: just east of the settlement. You need a Climbing Hook (one is in a house in the Abandoned Village further east).
Fighter: north-east of the settlement on a hill you can climb, guarded by a Beorcan group.
Archer: north-west of Valgr Ravine, high on the mountain. Approach from the north.
Thief: north-east of the Beorcan Stronghold near the main road. Hostiles around.
Sorcerer: south of the Beorcan Stronghold, across the lake north-west of the settlement.
Warrior: inside the Mad Lord's Chapel near the Shrine of Wisdom Portcrystal. Beat the Mad Lord.
Mystic Spearhand: north-east of Inner Valley Grotto. Opens after Sage's Wisdom: Riddle of the Body.
Magick Archer: Norgan Snowfield near the Snowslide Pass cave. Ghouls guard it.
Trickster: west of the marked spot using a Climbing Hook, or through the east exit of Gagana's Grotto. An ice dragon guards it.

tips.name: Slimes in Norgan
tips.body: Blue and purple slimes can only be killed with poison.

tips.name: Fatal D3D error / device hung
tips.body: A common PC crash. Try these one at a time and test after each.
steps: Verify the game files in Steam (right-click the game, Properties, Installed Files).
Turn off overlays (Steam, Discord, GPU tools) and close background apps.
Start the game in DirectX 11 mode if your launcher offers it.
Advanced: raise Windows' GPU timeout (TdrDelay in the registry). Back up the registry first.

tips.name: Failed to retrieve server information
tips.body: Online features (pawn rift) can't connect. Usually a server or network blip. Check your connection, restart the game and try again later.

tips.name: Error 0x2000000 (pawn creation)
tips.body: Reported when creating a pawn. No confirmed fix yet. Try restarting the game.

tips.name: Crashes to desktop
tips.body: Capcom's own advice: add the game to your antivirus exclusions, install Windows updates and verify the game files. Below minimum specs is not supported.

tips.name: Cyclops
tips.body: Big, slow giant with one eye.
steps: Aim for the eye, it is the weak spot.
Climb up and hit the head, or break its armour first.
Knock it down by hitting its legs, then go for the eye.

tips.name: Griffin
tips.body: Flying beast that swoops in and out.
steps: Use fire or ranged attacks to bring it down.
Grab its back and hit the wings to ground it.
Hang on when it flies, then drop and attack when it lands.

tips.name: Ogre
tips.body: Strong brute that charges and grabs.
steps: Its weak spot is the head.
Dodge the charges and attack its back.
It likes to grab women, so watch your female pawns.

tips.name: Minotaur
tips.body: Bull-headed charger.
steps: Dodge the charge sideways.
Break its horns.
Fire works well.

tips.name: Golem
tips.body: Stone construct powered by glowing discs.
steps: Destroy the glowing discs on its body.
Normal hits barely work until the discs are gone.
Climb it to reach the high ones.

tips.name: Drake
tips.body: A lesser dragon, a real test.
steps: Find its heart (a glowing spot on its chest) and hit it hard.
Holy and ice magic help. Fire usually doesn't.
Stay out of its breath attack.

tips.name: Medusa
tips.body: Snake-woman whose gaze turns you to stone.
steps: Don't look at her: stay behind her or crouch out of the gaze.
Cutting off her head gives you a Medusa Head that can petrify other enemies.
Carry potions that cure petrification.

tips.name: Lich
tips.body: Undead spellcaster.
steps: Holy magic does big damage.
Hit it during its casting animation.
Kill the undead it summons.

tips.name: Dullahan
tips.body: Headless horseman that appears at night.
steps: Holy damage works well.
Attack its glowing body pieces.
Bring a lantern and light sources.

tips.name: Chimera
tips.body: Three heads in one: lion, goat and snake.
steps: Cut off the snake tail first, it poisons you.
Then kill the goat head, which casts spells.
Finish the lion.

tips.name: Talos (the Gigantus)
tips.body: The giant from The Guardian Gigantus.
steps: Climb it and break its weak points one by one.
Breaking them all quickly earns an achievement.
